summary: The diff modifies the three frontend files specified in REQ-1 (CustomMapView.tsx, useMapTiles.ts, useMapTransform.ts) with safe Web Mercator math, zoom level capping to MAX_ZOOM=19, NaN/Infinity guards, coordinate clamping, and tile URL construction fixes.
